write_up: This is a strong store manager resume: your progression at Carolina Home & Garden comes with the store figures and results a recruiter needs. Your current role shows work across sales, staffing and inventory, not just a list of store duties.

The fixed-schedule line is a great model. It pairs a management decision with the change in annual turnover, so a recruiter can see what you did and what followed. Experience is already in the right place above Education.

Start by adding what changed at the other store behind your two-turnaround claim. Then add what you did behind the customer satisfaction ranking, if you can. Your resume is unlikely to be the reason you don't get a callback; competition for the role also matters.
